items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 19 July 2026 at 10:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Local strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred to the west of Ireland will continue to extend a ridge eastwards across Britain.


##Wind##

Mainly North or Northwest 4 or 5, but possibly touching 6 at times in the northwest of the area, from the North Channel to around parts of the west and north of the Isle of Man.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or Northwest 4 or 5, perhaps occasionally 6 towards the northwest of the area, then becoming generally Northwest 5 or 6 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
